correctness.rationale: Flat Fourier modulus is equivalent to vanishing nonzero cyclic autocorrelations. The first equation has three unit summands, forcing an equilateral triple; substitution into the second gives the fifth-root condition and exactly two cube-root branches. The converse is immediate from \(1+\omega+\omega^2=0\). The mod-15 verifier exactly confirms ten branches.

value.rationale: Complete equality cases on a canonical smallest nontrivial extreme support form a natural extremal classification and explain known witness nonuniqueness.

final_claim: For \(E=\{0,1,2,3\}\subset\mathbb Z_5\), every normalized extremal measure is \((1,t\omega^\varepsilon,t^2\omega^\varepsilon,t^3)\) with \(t^5=1\) and \(\varepsilon\in\{1,2\}\); hence exactly ten normalized extremizers in two modulation orbits exchanged by conjugation.
limitations: Specific to this support in \(\mathbb Z_5\).
